objective: Add visual WaterLevelGauge (Min/Target/Max indicator) to ThresholdsSection in Settings, including unit test coverage and frontend CI quality compliance.

acceptance.criterion: WaterLevelGauge renders Min, Target, and Max values with percentage labels and clamps fill width within 0-100%.
ThresholdsSection renders WaterLevelGauge with values from config above water level inputs.
Frontend CI quality checks pass with zero TypeScript errors, zero ESLint warnings, passing tests, and clean build.
acceptance.verification: Execution of npm run test, npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit, and npm run build in hydragrow-frontend
